auditor_jenna: Hi team — auditor request: please provide evidence for SOC 2 control mapping. Specifically: 1) RBAC change approvals and PR links for admin-role/grants for the past 6 months; 2) KMS key usage logs showing Decrypt/Encrypt calls tied to service accounts for the same window; 3) vuln triage notes for CVE-2025-1234 and mitigation dates; 4) incident timeline for the 2025-02-12 outage (INC-1234). Please confirm S3 export path with chain-of-custody and whether ephemeral keys were used. Target: EOD Wed.
jessica-sec: +1 — we'll collate. I'll pull PR approvals from GitHub, RBAC audit logs from the platform, and screenshots of signed approvals. Will include the control mapping doc.
mike-eng: For KMS usage, two quick queries:
```
# CloudTrail lookup for Decrypt events
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2024-09-01 --end-time 2025-03-01

# Splunk example
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=Encrypt) | table _time userIdentity.arn eventName resources requestParameters
```
I'll export matching events to CSV for the bundle.
sam-oncall: I have incident timeline + runbook notes. PagerDuty and Slack bridge logs attached to the runbook. I'll stage a snapshot at s3://redwood-evidence/audits/1761238910/INC-1234/ and add the runbook version.
audit_bot: Evidence bundle created: EB-20250301-7ce4. Upload endpoint: https://internal.redwood/evidence/EB-20250301-7ce4. (automated: please include manifest.json and checksums)
auditor_jenna: Thanks — can you also indicate which service accounts used ephemeral KMS keys vs long-lived keys? Need mapping by team and whether key rotation was automatic.
jessica-sec: Short answer: ephemeral keys used by model-serving-prod and ingestion-worker (rotated via our key-operator every 24h). Long-lived for kms-master-key used only for key wrapping/unwrapping. We'll annotate in the manifest and include KMS key policy screenshots.
mike-eng: Note: Decrypt calls from `svc-inference` spiked during the 02/12 outage — pulling the raw request IDs. Also exporting CloudTrail S3 objects (gzipped) to the evidence bucket; will include sample event JSON for each Decrypt.
sam-oncall: Linking INC-1234 -> runbook v2.1. CVE-2025-1234 triage assigned to @mike-eng; mitigation (hotfix) deployed 2025-02-14; creds rotated 2025-02-14T05:12Z. I'll attach the post-mortem blameless timeline and the remediation PR numbers.
auditor_jenna: Please ensure the chain-of-custody file is PGP-signed and includes SHA256 checksums for each artifact. Also need a short mapping doc: control ID -> evidence file path (one page).
jessica-sec: Understood. We'll PGP-sign manifest.json and attach checksums.txt. ETA tomorrow morning.
mike-eng: FYI commands used to create the CloudTrail export:
```
aws cloudtrail create-trail --name audit-export --s3-bucket-name redwood-evidence --is-multi-region-trail
aws cloudtrail start-logging --name audit-export
# then copy matching objects to audits/1761238910/
```
I'll also include the Splunk saved search and the raw CSV sample.
sam-oncall: Quick note: temporary session creds were rotated during the mitigation window; include session IDs in the CloudTrail export and note them in the manifest.
auditor_jenna: Appreciated. Ping me when EB-20250301-7ce4 is ready with manifest + checksums + mapping doc. :thumbsup:
